![mMediaTag & Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mBlinkii/mMediaTag/main/Logo/logo%20v4.png)

![mMediaTag Icon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mBlinkii/mMediaTag/main/Logo/icon%20v4.png)

**A Retail/Mainline plugin for ElvUI — Midnight ready and modular.**

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-mBlinkii%2FmMediaTag-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/mBlinkii/mMediaTag)
[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-mmediatag-F16436?logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/mmediatag)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20us-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.com/invite/ZScRCUyqjY)

---

`mMediaTag` adds a large collection of UI enhancements, custom media, utility datatexts, portrait styles, dock icons, tags, nameplate helpers, and quality of life tools on top of ElvUI.

This is the Midnight ready branch of the addon and focuses on a cleaner structure, better performance, and a more modular setup.

## What It Adds

- Custom portrait styles for multiple unit frames with support for class icons, spec icons, extra overlays, shadows, custom textures, and per unit placement.
- Dock style datatext icons for common panels such as character, friends, guild, dungeon finder, spellbook, talents, professions, mail, quests, bags, achievements, calendar, volume, encounter journal, and more.
- Utility datatexts such as Mythic+ score, teleports, professions, game menu, dungeon info, combat time, durability and item level, coordinates, and tracking helpers.
- Custom ElvUI tags for classification, health, status, role, level, faction, quest state, PvP state, power, class icons, and death counters.
- Nameplate helpers including target glow color syncing, an execute range marker, and highlight tools.
- Miscellaneous modules such as auto quest handling, auto role check acceptance, greeting messages, tooltip tweaks, minimap skins, data panel skins, Objective Tracker skinning, dice button, Details embedding, and LFG invite info.
- Built in media libraries for icons, portrait textures, dock assets, minimap art, and additional UI visuals.

## Highlights

- Built directly into the ElvUI options UI under `ElvUI > mMT`
- Modular setup so you can enable only the parts you actually use
- Extensive portrait customization for ElvUI layouts
- Dock icons that work with ElvUI datatext bars, including custom dock setups
- Optional integration with `Details` and `ElvUI_JiberishIcons`
- Localization files for `deDE`, `enUS`, `esES`, `esMX`, `frFR`, `itIT`, `koKR`, `ptBR`, `ruRU`, `zhCN`, and `zhTW`

## Requirements

- World of Warcraft Retail / Mainline
- ElvUI

Optional integrations:

- `Details` for embedded Details related features and class icon support
- `ElvUI_JiberishIcons` for additional icon integration when installed

## Installation

### CurseForge / Addon Manager

Install `mMediaTag` with your preferred addon manager and make sure `ElvUI` is already installed.

### Manual Installation

1. Download the latest packaged release.
2. Extract the addon folder.
3. Place `ElvUI_mMediaTag` inside your WoW addons directory:

```text
World of Warcraft\_retail_\Interface\AddOns\
```

4. Make sure the final folder name stays exactly `ElvUI_mMediaTag`.
5. Start the game and open `ElvUI > mMT`.

## Configuration

All addon settings are available in:

```text
ElvUI > mMT
```

Main sections include:

- `General`
- `Unitframes`
- `Nameplates`
- `Datatexts`
- `Dock`
- `TAGs`
- `Misc`
- `Colors`

If you want to build your own dock bar, create a custom ElvUI datatext bar and assign the `mMT` dock datatexts to its slots.

## Slash Commands

- `/mmt` opens the addon options
- `/mmt help` shows the command list
- `/mmt version` prints the current addon version
- `/mmt debug` toggles debug mode
- `/mmt debug safe` toggles debug mode with a reduced addon set

## Feature Overview

### Portraits

- Large bundled portrait texture library
- Support for player, target, targettarget, focus, pet, party, arena, and boss portraits
- Optional embellishments, shadows, extra textures, cast icons, and class/spec icon overlays
- Custom texture paths for users who want to extend the portrait system with their own assets

![Portraits example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mBlinkii/mMediaTag/main/Screenshot/screenshot_4.png)

### Dock System

- Icon first datatext modules with hover growth, color states, text labels, and notification markers
- Secure button support for click actions and macros
- Ready made modules for many common Blizzard and ElvUI destinations
- Flexible enough to assemble your own dock layout through ElvUI datatext bars

![Dock example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mBlinkii/mMediaTag/main/Screenshot/screenshot_5.png)

### Tags

- Classification tags for rare, elite, rare elite, and boss units
- Status tags for AFK, DND, offline, dead, and ghost states
- Role tags with text or icon output
- Health, level, power, faction, PvP, quest, and death count helpers
- Class icon tags with style specific output

### Nameplates and Utility Modules

- Target glow color can automatically match your class color
- Execute Marker showing your spec's execute range on enemy nameplates
- Highlight modules for target, focus, and quest units
- Auto quest accept and turn in with sensible restrictions
- Auto role check acceptance
- Details embedding into chat panel areas
- Objective Tracker skinning
- Custom minimap and panel skin options

## Current Branch Notes

- The `4.x` branch targets Retail/Mainline.
- This branch is Midnight focused and has been restructured heavily for the new version.
- According to the in addon changelog, `4.x` is not intended to be the Classic branch.

## Support

- GitHub: [mBlinkii/mMediaTag](https://github.com/mBlinkii/mMediaTag)
- Discord: [discord.com/invite/ZScRCUyqjY](https://discord.com/invite/ZScRCUyqjY)

## License

This project uses a custom license. In short:

- Private modifications are allowed.
- Redistribution of the addon is not allowed.
- Redistribution of the textures is not allowed.
- The addon's name and folder names must not be changed.

For the exact terms, see [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/mBlinkii/mMediaTag/blob/main/LICENSE.md).

releases.name: mMT v4.20
releases.notes:
## 🔧 Updates
- **[Tags]** The mMT-health and mMT-power tags show nothing instead of a 0 when the health, health percent or power percent is zero.
- **[Prey-Hunt]** The coloring of already defeated prey targets in the target list was removed.
- **[NP-Highlighters]** Units tagged by another player keep the tapped health color in the Classic versions and WoW Forever, can be turned off.
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** The icons of the buff bars can get their own size.

## ✨ New
- **[DT-Gold]** New datatext that tracks income, expenses and their sources plus the gold of all characters, with a day history, a daily goal and a gold goal, selectable click actions and text color.

releases.name: mMT v4.19
releases.notes:
## 🐛 Fixes
- **[System]** Errors could show up right after switching the profile, for example in the Buff-Reminder, Objective-Tracker, Keystone-Teleports and Prey-Hunt.
- **[Options]** The game froze when a right click on an mMT mover opened its settings page after the mMT settings had been open before.
- **[Buff-Reminder]** Low level rogues were reminded of poisons they had not learned yet.
- **[Buff-Reminder]** The weapon enchant was shown as missing although you had no weapon oil or weapon spell to apply.
- **[Buff-Reminder]** Raid buffs, pet and weapon spells were reminded before you had learned them.
- **[Buff-Reminder]** Gathering and crafting phials counted as a flask.
- **[Portraits]** Coloring portraits of hidden units in instances could cause small stutters.
- **[Keystone-Teleports]** The keys of the group members stayed in the list after a finished dungeon or after leaving the group.
- **[Tooltip-Icon]** The module failed to load in WoW Forever.
- **[Dock]** The durability and character icons showed no repair costs and no item level in WoW Forever.
- **[DT-Game-Menu]** Entries like the spellbook, collections and the shop were missing in WoW Forever.
- **[DT-Durability]** The item level was shown in Classic versions that have none.
- **[DT-Tracker]** Items that were not cached yet could stay empty.

## 🔧 Updates
- **[Buff-Reminder]** The reminder can hide after a set time and shows again when you enter a dungeon, raid, delve or scenario or join a group.
- **[Dispel-Icon]** The icons can be turned off to only use the frame highlight.
- **[System]** The Addon-Manager, Objective-Tracker and Cooldown-Manager are now also available in WoW Forever.
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** The settings including the mover positions can be exported and imported.
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** A max icon size keeps the icons of a fixed or matched size from getting too big when only a few are shown.

## ✨ New
- **[Enrage-Icon]** New module that shows enrage effects on the target, focus, boss and arena unitframes and on enemy nameplates as icons and can optionally highlight the frame.

releases.name: mMT v4.18
releases.notes:
## 🐛 Fixes
- **[Keystone-Teleports]** The flash could stay on the wrong dungeon when the rows were rearranged.
- **[Options]** Pages in the settings tree were greyed out although their module or a part of it was turned on.
- **[Unitframe-Icons]** The summon icon was turned on by default and its icon selection was empty.

## 🔧 Updates
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** Every module can now be attached to another module or to a frame like the unitframes and their power, class power and cast bars, and can match its width or height to it.
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** The icons of the custom tracker can be clicked to use the spell, item or equipment slot, and spells show their charges.
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** The font and font outline are now set for each text instead of once for all.
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** The settings are sorted into tabs and the modules are switched on and off in General.
- **[Keystone-Teleports]** The flash of the group dungeon now also adds a glowing border.
- **[NP-Highlighters]** The target, focus and quest highlights are now turned off by default like every other module.

## ✨ New
- **[Premade-Filter]** New module that adds a filter and sorting panel to the dungeon search of the group finder, with role, Bloodlust, region and dungeon filters, your applications on top and the leader score in the list.
- **[Merchant]** New modules for the vendor window that color items you already know and mark uncollected appearances, show 20 items per page in four columns and add a Max button to the quantity window.
- **[NP-CombatFade]** New module that fades, shrinks or hides enemy nameplates of units that are not in combat while you are fighting, optionally only in instances.
- **[Dispel-Icon]** New module that shows the dispel types of debuffs on friendly unitframes as icons and can optionally highlight the unitframe.
- **[System]** mMT now runs in WoW Classic Era, TBC Anniversary, Mists of Pandaria Classic and WoW Forever, features a game version does not have are left out and hidden in the settings.

## 📌 Info
- If you used the nameplate highlights or the summon icon without ever changing their settings, turn them on again.

releases.name: mMT v4.17
releases.notes:
## 🐛 Fixes
- **[Buff-Reminder]** Midnight weapon oils were not found in the bags, so the weapon enchant icon could not use them.
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** The pandemic highlight cost CPU time on every frame for each aura, it now only reacts when an aura enters or leaves the pandemic window.

## 🔧 Updates
- **[Buff-Reminder]** Each check can be limited to the open world, dungeons, raids or delves and scenarios.
- **[Dock]** The mail dock opens a menu with your mailbox toys and auction house mounts on click, a random ready toy on top, and shows the toy cooldowns in the tooltip.
- **[Dock]** Right click on the character dock switches equipment sets and its tooltip lists them, on the collections dock summons a random favorite mount or pet or opens a collection tab, and on the housing dock teleports you to your plot.
- **[Dock]** CTRL + left click on the volume dock sets the master volume.
- **[DT-Dungeon]** Right click on the dungeon and M+ score datatexts and the dungeon dock opens a menu for the Dungeon Finder, Raid Finder, Premade Groups, Mythic+, PvP and the Great Vault.
- **[DT-Durability]** Right click on the datatext and the durability dock opens a menu with all your repair mounts and a random one on top, the mount no longer has to be chosen in the settings.
- **[Keystone-Teleports]** Warns when the group leader has left the group or the dungeon difficulty is not set to Mythic.

releases.name: mMT v4.16
releases.notes:
## 🐛 Fixes
- **[Cooldown-Manager]** The custom tracker showed no icon for equipment slots and missed spells that replace another one.
- **[System]** Fixed errors and missing icons with WoW 12.1.5, among them in the profession, tracker, score and dungeon datatexts.

## 🔧 Updates
- **[System]** Updated for WoW 12.1.5.
- **[System]** Switched to the current Blizzard API, mMT no longer relies on Blizzard's deprecated fallbacks.
